layers.title: Region outline
layers.source: HDX Common Operational Datasets, Bangladesh admin level 3

layers.title: Terrain (hillshade)
layers.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA / Airbus), open data on AWS
layers.method: Window read of the public tiles, merged to UTM, hillshade at azimuth 315 and altitude 45 degrees
layers.limitations: A surface model, so it includes buildings and trees and smooths low flat land. Not a flood model.

layers.title: NISAR surface change
layers.source: NISAR L-band GCOV, NASA / ISRO, via NASA Earthdata (ASF DAAC)
layers.limitations: Detects open water only: flooded villages, crops and streets are missed (the double-bounce effect), so the flooded area is a lower bound.
layers.method: Ratio of the two dates in dB, threshold by Otsu's method, permanent water and steep ground excluded, patches under 8 pixels dropped. See sar-flood/METHODOLOGY.md.
